items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: slow drag, he got out right away because he had to, uh, former Mayor Mason's brother and he got him out.

ctx.x: How'd that happen you got raided?

Well, they had a flow show on that night. Oh, yeah? And, uh, some woman was in there, didn't like the way their entertainers was dressed. Didn't like the costume they had, half-naked, you know? And this fella Joe that was operating the place, he was, he was a kind of a little gangster in a sly way. He wasn't paying off the police one. Mm-hmm. So somebody reported these women in there on the flow show and they come down there that night and they raided the place and took us all to jail. Well, drag he got out right…
Well, uh, when you went to school, did they teach music there? No.
